scope: Strict artifact validation, freshness and causality, Eastern-time event boundaries, append-only local journal, concurrent transactions, outcome links, immutable event revisions and last-good output retention.
evidence: Injected software tests only; initial calendar facts separately verified against linked official pages.
firstRunFinding: The initial Windows run caught unclosed SQLite connection handles during temporary-file cleanup. Explicit connection.close() fixed the resource leak; both final suites passed.
limitations: No profitability, broker execution, predictive calibration, or live quote behavior was tested.
The local journal is not a trusted public timestamp and is not automatically uploaded.
No native macOS execution was available; WSL is not evidence of a separate VPS deployment.
